# mv: removeDecl handles short variable declaration (:= to = conversion)
mv f.x s.X
-- x.go --
package p

type S struct{ Y int }

var s S

func f() {
	x := 1
	_ = x
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -1,10 +1,13 @@
 package p

-type S struct{ Y int }
+type S struct {
+	Y int
+	X int
+}

 var s S

 func f() {
-	x := 1
-	_ = x
+	s.X = 1
+	_ = s.X
 }
